demos.title: japan(demo)
demos.desc: A demo that draws everything with one camera — from Japan's city data (PLATEAU) to the Solar System, from flat maps to 3D maps.

demos.title: Equal Earth
demos.desc: A scrolling Equal Earth world map with choropleths. Right-click any point to turn it into a 3D globe centered there.

demos.title: World quiz
demos.desc: A geography quiz for kids and grown-ups: flags, capitals and where countries are on the 3D globe. Three levels, the whole world or one region, stars and badges — and the countries you miss come back until you know them.

shot.eval: (async () => { const want = 'IT', wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const key = () => decodeURIComponent((document.querySelector('#view-quiz .q-prompt img.q-flag')?.src.split('/flags/')[1] ?? '').replace(/\.svg.*$/, '')); for (let n = 0; n < 800 && key() !== want; n++) { document.querySelector('#view-quiz .q-quit').click(); document.querySelector('#view-home .q-start').click(); await wait(20); } const b = document.querySelector('#view-quiz .q-choice[data-key="' + want + '"]'); if (!b) return; const st = window.setTimeout; window.setTimeout = (f, ms, ...a) => ms === 1600 ? 0 : st(f, ms, ...a); b.click(); window.setTimeout = st; await wait(8000); for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('#map *')) if (!e.children.length && /^\d{4}\/\d\d\/\d\d/.test(e.textContent.trim())) e.style.visibility = 'hidden'; })()

demos.title: geoedit
demos.desc: A map editor. Draw and fix shapes on the 3D globe, and save them as GIS data.

demos.title: Nations of the World
demos.desc: Basic data for the countries and territories of the world, as cards — facts, flag and anthem, Wikipedia and map.

demos.title: Landforms of the World
demos.desc: Mountains, rivers, lakes, seas and deserts of the world on a 3D globe — rank them, compare their heights and lengths, and overlay ocean currents, plate boundaries and climate zones.

demos.title: National Parks of the United States
demos.desc: All 63 national parks of the United States on a 3D globe — photos, the National Park Service's boundaries, facts and Wikipedia links.

demos.title: World clock
demos.desc: What time is it there? The local time of every time zone on a 3D globe, with daylight saving time and the night side — hover a place, or hold Shift for a whole country.

demos.title: World population in hexagons
demos.desc: Where the world's 8 billion people live, as hexagonal columns on a 3D globe (H3 cells, Kontur Population). Zoom in for finer hexagons, drop your own points to count them.

demos.title: The shortest way is an arc
demos.desc: On a globe the shortest way between two places is a great circle. Arcs from anywhere to every capital, 37,000 air routes, great circle vs rhumb line, and your own CSV.

demos.title: World earthquakes
demos.desc: Reads USGS earthquake data directly and shows each quake in 3D by its energy and depth. It can also play year by year or month by month.

demos.title: Satellites
demos.desc: The current positions of satellites from CelesTrak data. Click a satellite to draw its orbit in 3D.

demos.title: Clouds now
demos.desc: Infrared images from five geostationary weather satellites (Himawari, GOES, Meteosat), read straight from NASA GIBS and EUMETSAT and drawn in 3D over the globe.

demos.title: ortho-solar
demos.desc: The current positions of the planets and their moons — and a replay of how they move over time.

demos.title: Daily calendar
demos.desc: A Japanese tear-off calendar (lunisolar date, rokuyō, solar terms, holidays) with sunrise, sunset, twilight and the Moon for where you stand, computed with your elevation. Scroll a week without end; add your own iCal.

demos.title: Make a video
demos.desc: Cut out scenes of the 3D map and save or play them as one continuous video.

demos.title: GeoPBF
demos.desc: Drop a GIS file, check it on the globe, write it in another format — 18 formats in, 14 out. The file never leaves your machine.

demos.title: MapLibre examples
demos.desc: All 139 official MapLibre GL JS examples, run unchanged on the ortho-earth globe. Each card shows how closely it matches MapLibre; press Run to try it, or copy the code.

demos.title: Japan's open GIS data
demos.desc: View and convert the open GIS data published in Japan.

demos.title: census2020
demos.desc: Drill down into Japan's 2020 census — small-area statistics, disaster risk zones and land parcels.

demos.title: Yokohama digital twin
demos.desc: A digital twin of Yokohama: PLATEAU 3D buildings with flood, storm surge, tsunami and landslide hazards, evacuation sites, aerial photos from 1945 to today, building shadows, viewsheds and cross sections.

demos.title: Satellite data (COG)
demos.desc: Satellite images (COG) on a server (Tellus), laid over the globe in 3D.

demos.title: ortho-japan
demos.desc: A map drawn only from Japan's public data. Try out the basic features.

demos.title: National Parks of Japan
demos.desc: All 35 national parks of Japan on a 3D globe — photos, the official boundaries, facts and Wikipedia links.

demos.title: Hot springs of Japan
demos.desc: About 2,000 hot springs of Japan from Wikipedia on a 3D map, colored by spring type, with onsen districts, distant sources and member inns of the Japan Secluded Hot Spring Association.

demos.title: Landforms of Japan
demos.desc: Mountains, volcanoes, rivers, lakes, plains, islands and seas of Japan on a 3D map, with their heights, lengths, areas and depths side by side.

demos.title: GLB models
demos.desc: Landmarks such as Tokyo Tower, placed on the globe as GLB models. Download them in a range of 3D formats.

demos.title: Fireworks over Sumida
demos.desc: Full-scale fireworks (a 10-inch shell opens 320 m wide at 330 m) launched over the Sumida River, hidden by the buildings and Tokyo Skytree in front of them.

demos.title: Statistics in 3D
demos.desc: A 3D graph from the 2020 census — every municipality raised by its population density.

demos.title: An old map of Edo
demos.desc: A woodblock map of Nihonbashi from 1850, read as IIIF tiles straight from the National Diet Library and laid on today's Tokyo by its control points.

demos.title: Point clouds of Shizuoka
demos.desc: Laser point clouds of Shizuoka Prefecture (VIRTUAL SHIZUOKA): pick a survey and a map sheet, and the open data is read straight from the prefecture's files and drawn on the 3D map. Change the point size and colours, and fit the heights to the terrain.

demos.title: ortho-nl
demos.desc: The Netherlands in 3D — 3DBAG buildings standing on OpenStreetMap vector tiles and terrain. Hop between eight cities, from Delft to Maastricht.
